lines.rationale: Line 1 describes 'Layover FR 4PK' with measurements and retainer rail slot details, evidently a wire shelving or shelving component. The catalog contains specific codes for wire shelving, with 'WIRE SHELVING' matching the nature and commodity, so task_code 5225 is selected. Asset_class_code is not directly provided as Europe classes are not listed. AMBIGUOUS is used for residual uncertainty (could cover retainer or divider), but task code is cited.

Line 2 is nearly identical to line 1: 'Layover FR 1PK' with measurements, for shelving or rail system, matching 'WIRE SHELVING' catalog descriptions. Catalog covers multiple wire shelving entries (5225, 5225A, 5225B), but main 5225 covers generic wire shelving, so task_code 5225 is selected. Asset_class_code unavailable. AMBIGUOUS due to wire retainer versus shelving ambiguity.

Line 3: 'Reinforced Lock-In 2 Wire divider' is a shelf divider or organizational wire shelf part. Catalog 'WIRE SHELVING' matches both shelving and wire divider items, task_code 5225 is closest. Some ambiguity remains (could be auxiliary part), so status AMBIGUOUS. Asset_class_code unavailable.

Line 4: Similar 'Reinforced Lock-In 2 Wire divider', 10PK, matches catalog 'WIRE SHELVING', appropriate for shelf divider wire components. Ambiguity persists regarding exact catalog fit, so status AMBIGUOUS. Asset_class_code unavailable.

Line 5: 'FlexRoller Clear Retainer', a component for shelving or shelf system, best fits 'WIRE SHELVING' in catalog (task_code 5225). No Europe asset class catalog, so AMBIGUOUS status. Asset_class_code unavailable.

Line 6: 'FlexRoller Clear Retainer' (mini), similarly matches 'WIRE SHELVING' catalog item (task_code 5225, organizational shelving/retainer/wire), though may overlap with other subcodes. Asset_class_code unavailable, ambiguity remains.

Line 7: 'FR Back Wire Retainer' for shelving, fits in 'WIRE SHELVING' as retainer/wire shelving component (task_code 5225). Ambiguity persists as catalog does not distinguish retainer from divider. Asset_class_code unavailable.

Line 8: 'Infostrip 10PK', labeling component for shelving, may not exactly match 'WIRE SHELVING' catalog, but no other code covers shelving label accessory. AMBIGUOUS assigned, task_code 5225 as closest fit.

Line 9: 'Infostrip 10PK', double wire mount, again a labeling strip for shelving. Catalog lacks dedicated label code but task_code 5225 is closest fit for shelving wire accessories. AMBIGUOUS assigned. Asset_class_code unavailable.

Line 10: 'Reinforced Lock-In Wire divider' for shelving (20-Pack), as above, fits 'WIRE SHELVING' catalog task_code 5225. Some ambiguity persists as catalog does not list separate divider code. Asset_class_code unavailable.
Line 11: 'Reinforced Lock-In Wire divider' (10-Pack) for shelving, matches 'WIRE SHELVING' in catalog, with ambiguity as for line 10. Asset_class_code unavailable.
Line 12: 'Shipping' is freight and not a cataloged asset or component. Task catalog does not cover freight/shipping. UNAVAILABLE assigned; asset_class_code also unavailable.
